groups.label: Kernel shape (decided once, lived with forever)

items.title: Kernel is pure Kotlin with zero Android imports (Kotlin Multiplatform-ready)
items.note: Lets the same kernel power desktop, iOS, JS/WASM ports later. Retrofitting KMP after Android types leak in is a rewrite.

items.title: Strict layering: kernel → platform adapters → UI → libraries → app; lower layers never import higher ones
Single-activity architecture with a framework-owned root composable (AxfRoot)
Compose-first UI with an explicit AndroidView interop seam (no XML layouts in the framework)
One state model: immutable state + reducers + serializable snapshots (process-death restore)
Concurrency contract: structured coroutines, injected dispatchers, main-safe APIs, cancellation rules
One Result/Failure type used by every kernel and library API
One serializer (kotlinx.serialization) with unknown-field tolerance everywhere
items.note: Old apps must load newer assets without crashing.

items.title: Clock, ID generator, random and locale injected (never called statically)
DI container boundary: framework-owned graph, Hilt-compatible, every module declares its bindings
Min SDK / target SDK / Kotlin / Compose BOM versions pinned in a version catalog
Global ID + namespace scheme (ai.amberx.<port>.<module>.<thing>) for modules, assets, actions, permissions, routes, settings, events
Kernel API version + semver for every module; capability negotiation at load
Explicit public vs internal API (explicit API mode, @AxfInternal annotation, binary-compat validator)
Asset envelope versioning path: asset@1 now, asset@2 migration hooks declared, unknown types tolerated
Migration registry (assets, settings, databases, manifest) with ordered, idempotent steps
Deprecation policy and shims (nothing is ever removed without a shim + migration)
Manifest + lock conformance rules extended for Android (baked file hashes, module list, targets)
Feature flags + kill switches wired into the kernel from day one
AxfModule contract: id, version, deps, provides/requires capabilities, lifecycle (register → init → start → stop)
Extension point registry with typed slots (menus, routes, settings pages, actions, asset types, theme sources, log sinks, auth providers, billing providers…)
items.note: Everything later plugs in here instead of editing the kernel.

items.title: Typed placeholder/stub mechanism: every declared capability has a NotImplemented adapter that fails gracefully
Dynamic feature module support decided up front (base-module manifest + split install seam)
Deterministic module init order from the dependency graph + cycle detection
Asset type registry is open: new asset types can be registered by modules without a kernel change
Typed event bus with ordering + replay semantics defined now
Port registry placeholders: react/next, angular, python, desktop, iOS, wear, tv, auto, web-component
Typed action descriptors: description + JSON Schema input/output, effect, idempotent, long-running, streams (auto-generates MCP tools)
Default-deny exposure per action/event: LOCAL / LINKED (other AXF apps) / REMOTE (protocol adapters)
Call origins + remote callers: external calls must pass the caller's grants AND the app's UAC role; audited with correlation ids
Value-returning callable actions alongside fire-and-forget action-bus handlers
Protocol adapter extension point + guarded ProtocolHost (MCP, axf-link, axHub connector plug in as modules, never kernel changes)
surface@1 self-description of everything an app exposes, per audience
Stable wire error codes mapped to and from AxfFailure
Job manager for long-running external calls (progress, cancel, poll) — capability axf.jobs
Outbound RemoteServices: app code calls MCP servers / axHub services / other apps through one interface — capability axf.remote
Appearance source: developer apps take their appearance + settings documents from the axHub data server (appearance@1), waiting screen while the hub is unreachable
items.note: core/engines/appearance.ts = kernel AppearanceEngine; web HubAppearanceSource, Android lib-hub; opt-in per app (manifest developer: { hub })

items.title: Tokens are the only way to style: no literal colors/sizes/fonts in any framework component
Complete token vocabulary fixed now (color, type, shape, space, elevation, motion, opacity, z-index, icon, breakpoints)
Composition locals contract (LocalAxfTheme, LocalAxfRuntime, LocalAxfActions, LocalAxfLayout, LocalAxfUac)
Layout region contract (menubar, toolbar, nav, main, inspector, status, fab, sheet, overlay) + how new regions are added
Adaptive window size classes (compact/medium/expanded) and posture (foldable) in the layout engine from the start
Accessibility semantics required on every component (contentDescription, roles, min touch target, font scaling)
Every user-visible string goes through the string asset layer; RTL mirroring supported
Action id grammar (ns.verb, args with ':', {payload}) + shortcut/gesture mapping contract
UAC permission id namespacing + wildcard grammar shared across ports
Hot-swap boundary: which assets swap live vs need recompose vs need restart, defined per asset type
Motion/animation contract (durations, easings, reduced-motion, shared element seam)
Icon contract: icon names in assets resolve through a registry (never hard references)
Typed route + deep-link scheme (axf://<app>/<route>) owned by the kernel; modules register routes
Screen result passing + back-stack ownership rules
Schema-driven filesystem layout per app and per module (namespaced dirs, cache vs data vs export)
Database strategy: one Room DB per module, shared migration registry, export format
Settings schema registry: typed keys, groups, scopes (app/user/device), defaults, migrations
Secure storage boundary (Keystore) + rule: secrets never live in assets or logs
Permission engine abstraction (declare → rationale → request → fallback) used by every library
Offline-first data contract (local source of truth, outbox, sync hooks) in the repository base class
Backup + data-extraction rules and export/import envelope defined now
Structured logging API (tags, levels, fields, redaction) used by every module from the first line
Telemetry/analytics/crash hooks interface (vendor-free) in the kernel
Error reporting + user-facing error mapping in the kernel
Security baseline: network security config, cert pinning seam, root/tamper hooks, R8 keep rules for reflection
Gradle convention plugins + version catalog + module naming (axf-*, lib-*, app-*)
Package naming (ai.amberx.axf.*), applicationId scheme, flavors/suffixes
Manifest contribution strategy: each module contributes its own manifest pieces
Publishing: Maven local + GitHub Packages for framework artifacts so apps depend by version
Signing + release channel + in-app update seam
Test seams: fake kernel, fake modules, fake clock/network, screenshot harness
Performance baseline: startup budget, baseline profiles, lazy module init, strict-mode in debug
Build-engine bridge (HTTP + MCP) and `axf init --targets android` template
Repository layout: framework/android/* for the port, apps/* for apps, shared framework/assets JSON
Shared Python server helpers (axf_server): sign-in wall, private storage, safe outbound HTTP, credentials, console client, plugin package checks
items.note: One copy for every AXF app server (console, plugins, Build Pilot); cross-language parts pinned by spec/fixtures (wall-signature, plugin-package).
